scope: Third four-hour site-wide improvement round. Preserve existing dates, URLs, anchors and draft states; publish verified changes through main.

findings.evidence: A native disabled button retained focus during writeText but emitted focusout on a later frame while the promise remained pending. aria-disabled/aria-busy plus an activation guard keep it focusable without duplicate writes.

findings.status: fixed; changed selection and background-tab checks passed
findings.evidence: After Tab and a new paragraph selection, permission rejection focused the earlier pre and replaced the selection. Manual selection now requires unchanged focus/selection and an active document.

findings.status: fixed; 540 ordinary and forced-color cases passed
findings.evidence: 126 tested custom outline cases were below 3:1. The new check targets outline styles; related cards use a separate existing border indication and are excluded.

findings.status: fixed; nine tests passed on Python 3.10/3.13 and tqdm 4.70.0/4.67.1
findings.evidence: Passing iter([[1,2],[],[3]]) computes total=3 during a first traversal, then processes no batches and fails its final assertion.

findings.status: fixed; 270 screen cases and three print modes passed
findings.evidence: In forced-light mode with a dark site theme, canvas axes kept #cbd8e8 on white (1.4456:1). In forced-dark mode with a light theme, #465a70 remained on black (2.9569:1). CSS foreground had correctly switched; canvas pixels had not.

findings.status: fixed; 564 normal and 564 forced-color article print layouts passed
findings.evidence: The expanded canvas check passed all 270 screen layouts, but forced-dark print changed the paper background to black despite the existing white print CSS. Its canvas axes and truth trace fell below the contrast target.
findings.change: Retain the established light print palette with inherited forced-color-adjust:none only in print media.

findings.status: fixed; short-block focus retained and cleanup after blur passed
findings.evidence: At desktop width the short process/PID code block selected the correct text, but its layout observer removed tabindex and blurred the manual-copy target. The expanded clipboard check failed with focused=false, exact=true.
findings.change: Keep tabindex while the pre is focused; schedule cleanup after blur.

findings.status: fixed; 36 layout cases, five modifier cases, legacy anchor and fragment history passed
findings.evidence: Holding the TOC frame, selecting a chapter and then pressing Tab moved focus to the permalink; flushing the old frame moved it back to H2. Chapter navigation is now synchronous and leaves modifier clicks to the browser.

ci_changes.environment: Dedicated venv under RUNNER_TEMP; existing Hugo and standard-library validation steps are unchanged.
ci_changes.local_status: nine tests passed in an isolated Python 3.13 environment

release.status: first batch locally validated; upload pending

visual_review.status: four screenshots inspected; native print restores forced-dark screen colors afterward
